QUOTE: platform.c:25-32 falls back to `platform_calloc_uninit`, which always returns NULL. Every allocation then fails until the project calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the uninitialised calloc returns NULL, but it never states that the uninitialised free does nothing, so the item's fact is only half there.
